text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT 2139500000 — autoscaler thrash detected in prod-eu (cluster=eu-west-2). Rapid scale up/down between ~6↔️48 nodes over last 10m. Multiple serving pods in CrashLoopBackOff. Errors: CUDA OOM / driver Xid entries, container restarts. Paging on-call.

maria: ack oncall, looking. Oncall = maria (eu). Pulling metrics + logs now.

jonathan: I'm up — joining. Any customer-facing impact yet?

maria: yes, latency spikes and 5xx for embedding endpoints. Preliminary: p95 latency 4.2s -> 18s for some tenants; error rate ~4.8% across routes; a handful of VIP customers seeing 503s.

kai: seeing repeated Xid 31 + CUDA OOM in logs. Snippet from one pod below:

```
2026-03-15T03:05:12Z serving-runtime[pid=1124]: cuda error: out of memory (OOM)
2026-03-15T03:05:12Z runtime: kernel failure: Xid 31, GPU 0
2026-03-15T03:05:12Z kubelet: Pod mymodel-serve-7bddf9 crashed (OOM) restart_count=4
```

maria: also seeing node flaps — kube nodes repeatedly NotReady after GPU driver resets. nvidia-smi on node-23:

```
# nvidia-smi
Thu Mar 15 03:06:00 2026
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 525.85.12   Driver Version: 525.85.12   CUDA Version: 11.8     |
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
|  0   A100-SXM4     Off          | 00000000:3D:00.0 Off |                  N/A |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Processes:                                                                  |
|  PID   Type   Process name         GPU Memory Usage                         |
| 1124   C      python                38.6Gi / 40Gi                           |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

maria: looks like a memory leak for certain models + autoscaler bouncing creates pressure -> OOM -> driver resets -> node NotReady -> autoscaler triggers again. Classic feedback loop.

anya: paging PD now. @pagerduty please escalate to SRE rotation and support.

pagerduty: PagerDuty notified — incident sev: high. Escalating to SRE lead.

maria: immediate mitigation plan (short term):
- disable autoscale burst / set stable min nodes to 12
- increase cluster autoscaler cooldown to 600s (from 120s)
- cordon the 3 suspected flapping nodes and drain gracefully
- pin heavy-serving model to quantized variant (v1.2-quant) to reduce GPU mem footprint
- divert a percentage of traffic to prod-us fallback (20%) for highest latency customers
- update status page (Elyse to coordinate)

jonathan: agree. I can run the autoscaler toggle and cordon/drain commands.

kai: adding commands I'm running now:

```
# disable burst/autoscale temporary
kubectl patch cm cluster-autoscaler -n kube-system --type merge -p '{"data":{"scaleDownDelayAfterAdd":"600s","maxNodesTotal":"200","enableBurst":"false"}}'

# set min nodes for pool
gcloud container node-pools update gpu-pool --cluster prod-eu --min-nodes=12 --region europe-west2

# cordon suspected nodes
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-23-45
kubectl drain ip-10-0-23-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```

maria: applied autoscaler cooldown patch and set min nodes to 12. Disabling burst. Will monitor.

(5m later)

kai: drained two problematic nodes; third node under investigation by infra; GPU driver consistently failing on that host — raised infra ticket.

maria: rolling model pin for heavy route to quantized v1.2 now (canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%). Using canary rollout to avoid mass restarts.

```
# example rollout patch
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://internal-api.redwood/services/mymodel/rollout -d '{"version":"v1.2-quant","canary":0.1}'
```

jonathan: started traffic shift: routing 20% high-latency customers -> prod-us (us-west-1) via smart-routing policies.

elyse: support notes — opened support incident for impacted customers. Drafting status page: "We are experiencing elevated error rates and latency in EU region due to autoscaler instability and GPU OOMs. Traffic mitigation in progress." Will post once we confirm improvements.

maria: quick impact snapshot after immediate mitigations (10m):
- overall error rate down from 4.8% -> 1.1%
- p95 latency for embeddings improved from 18s -> 6.1s (still degraded vs baseline ~400ms)
- two VIP customers moved to fallback; one reported intermittent 503s resolved after reroute
- no new CUDA Xid 31 logs on canary quantized pods so far

kai: infra found that a kernel module on node-23 was loading older driver bits; rebased driver package for node image. Planning a controlled restart for that node after cordon.

maria: next steps medium-term:
- add damping to autoscaler to avoid flip-flop (change policy -> target utilization with slower reaction)
- short-term: increase min nodes to 15 for EU during business hours
- long-term: add GPU driver self-heal daemon to reboot only GPU consumers not entire node; improve health checks for runtime crash loops
- create postmortem and RCA owners: SRE/Kai, Runtime team/Maria, Autoscaler team/Jonathan

anya: documenting timeline and owner list in incident doc.

pagerduty: PD note: on-call handoff will occur in 40m. Current responders: maria (lead), jonathan (backup), kai (infra), elyse (support).

maria: handing off the active shift to jonathan at 2139501800. Jon, you own the mitigation from here and the incident timeline for postmortem. I'll remain reachable for runtime questions.

jonathan: taking over. Summary of current state: autoscaler burst disabled, min nodes=12, cooldown=600s, model canary to quant v1.2 50%, 20% traffic routed to prod-us, two flapping nodes drained, one pending infra driver fix. Monitoring dashboards show error rate trending down.

jonathan: immediate action I'll take: keep autoscale disabled for 30m; schedule node restart for fixed driver image; coordinate with infra to replace bad node if restart doesn't clear; start postmortem doc skeleton.

maria: thanks — ping me if we see re-emergence of Xid patterns.

(incident note)

ops-bot: Incident updated — severity: high -> mitigated. Metrics: errors decreased 4.8% -> 1.0% in 25m. New events suppressed.

jonathan: marking as mitigation in place. Will run follow-up tests (load + long-tail sequences) overnight to ensure no regression. Postmortem owner assigned: jonathan.

elyse: status page posted and support notified affected customers. Will send customer follow-ups with remediation steps and expected timeline.

maria: closing active paging. Handoff complete at 2139501830. We'll keep this thread for postmortem updates. :white_check_mark:
